user.title: Connect your HackRF
user.description: Choose where the HackRF USB device is connected.

menu_options.bridge: USB bridge (recommended for Home Assistant OS)
menu_options.local: Local USB (Core / Container with HackRF tools)

local.title: Check local USB
local.description: Install hackrf_info and hackrf_sweep inside the Home Assistant runtime and allow access to the USB device. For Home Assistant OS, use the bridge instead. Select Submit to discover accessible radios. A PortaPack must be in HackRF mode.

bridge.title: Connect to the HackRF bridge
bridge.description: Run the supplied bridge on the Linux computer with the HackRF attached. Enter its URL and HACKRF_BRIDGE_TOKEN. Use HTTPS on untrusted networks. The token stays on the Home Assistant backend.

device.title: Select and protect your radio
device.description: Receive-only monitoring. RF amplifier and antenna bias power are locked OFF. Keep HackRF One input below -5 dBm; use appropriate attenuation and DC blocking for the connected equipment. Relative FFT readings cannot enforce that physical limit. Initial setup does not flash firmware. Reviewed firmware maintenance is a separate admin workflow. See [hardware guidance]({hardware_guidance_url}).

data.name: Name
data.acknowledge_input_safety: I have checked RF input power and external DC protection for this board

error.cannot_connect: Cannot access a compatible HackRF. Check USB permissions, cable, bridge URL/logs, host tools, firmware support, other SDR apps and PortaPack HackRF mode. Reported incompatible firmware and failed self-tests block scanning.
error.invalid_auth: The bridge rejected the access token.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP(S) URL without embedded credentials, query or fragment.
error.invalid_device: Select an accessible compatible radio from the list.
error.safety_required: Check the RF input and external DC protection before proceeding.

abort.already_configured: This hardware serial number is already configured.

init.title: Receive settings
init.description: Applying settings stops monitoring. Use whole MHz endpoints, a span of 1-100 MHz inside 1-6000 MHz, and at most 20000 FFT bins. The tool rounds the upper edge to a 20 MHz tuning step; the rounded edge must also remain at or below 6000 MHz. RF amplifier and antenna power remain off.

error.invalid_settings: Invalid receive settings. Check frequency range and rounded upper edge, bin count, gain steps, interval (5-3600 seconds) and threshold (-150 to 0 dB).
